sourceText: Develop the human-approved ProofStory Acceptance Topology Wave 1: add verificationIntent-owned planned-path declarations, reference-only acceptance topology diagnostics, and a deterministic read-only acceptance matrix, while preserving legacy Stories and lifecycle behavior.
normalizedOutcome: Running lattice acceptance_matrix for a topology-enabled or legacy Story displays deterministic canonical source IDs and explicit observe-only diagnostics, without writing evidence or changing lifecycle state.
acceptanceClaim: Wave 1 provides a canonical, reference-only and non-gating acceptance-topology projection that reveals proof-design gaps before REVIEW without creating a second completion truth source.
